title: Waymo research pilot - stopped lead vehicle - lane departure
notice: This CARLA research illustration was made using a model trained on the Waymo Open Dataset provided by Waymo LLC. It is released under the Waymo Dataset License Agreement for Non-Commercial Use. Downstream use and modification are subject to that agreement, including the non-commercial restrictions in Section 4.
result: Lane departure. At the only frame with an in-path gap below 12 m, the lead-vehicle gap was 11.98 m, ego speed was 5.55 m/s, and the controller commanded zero brake for the following tick. This trial did not demonstrate a safe response to the stopped lead vehicle.
evidence_scope: One selected non-commercial research transfer run. All footage, sensor returns and motion observations were generated inside CARLA. Benchmark results are computed separately.
controller: Pure pursuit at predicted t=1s, speed from 0.5-to-1s chord, forward gear. Steer from CARLA 1.0 Lincoln tire-angle table. Speed error / 0.75 s; requested acceleration limited to [-4,2] m/s²; feedforward normalized by measured full throttle 7.5 or nominal brake 4 m/s² and integral correction from observed acceleration. No speed cap.

camera_rig.difference: CARLA rendered pinhole cameras on a Lincoln, with fixed poses and FOV. No calibration match to the recorded Waymo cameras.

route_command: Planned tangent change over max(10 m, speed * 10 s), 30 degree turn threshold.
waypoints: 20 XY in metres, forward/left from current rear axle, 0.25 to 5 seconds
observer_notes: LiDAR, radar, detector tracks, modeled thermal and simulator truth are viewer/scoring only.
timing: The 35 recorded sensor frames begin at t=0 and end at t=3.4 s. The MP4 containers hold the final frame for one 0.1 s interval. Model commands in each frame target the following tick when applied_for_next_tick is true.
